CustomField.description: Annual interest rate. Percent type with three decimals so a rate quoted in basis points survives without rounding. The _Pct__c suffix follows the type-suffix discipline for a Number whose name would otherwise read categorical, and it makes clear at the call site that the stored value is a percentage rather than a decimal fraction.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Annual interest rate as a percentage, for example 6.375 for six and three eighths percent.
CustomField.label: Interest Rate %
